name: Toast
description: A transient notification system. Individual Toast items stack in a fixed portal region. ToastProvider wraps the app and provides context. The useToast hook exposes an imperative toast() API for programmatic creation.

accessibility.role: status (polite) or alert (assertive for danger variant)
notes: The toast container uses aria-live='assertive' for danger toasts and aria-live='polite' for all others.
aria-atomic='true' ensures screen readers announce the full toast message.
Toasts auto-dismiss after the duration prop expires (default 5000ms).
Pass duration=0 for persistent toasts that require manual dismissal.
Toasts are rendered in a Portal attached to document.body.

title.description: Bold heading of the toast notification.

description.description: Optional supporting text beneath the title.

duration.description: Auto-dismiss delay in milliseconds. Pass 0 for persistent toast.

onClose.description: Called when the toast is dismissed (auto or manual).

labels.description: Override default labels for internationalisation. ToastLabels: { dismiss: string }.

subcomponents.ToastProvider: Wraps the application. Required to use useToast. Accepts a position prop.
subcomponents.useToast: Hook that returns { toast(options) } for imperative creation.

position.description: Screen position for the toast stack.

labels.description: Override default labels for internationalisation. ToastProviderLabels: { notifications: string }.

do: Use ToastProvider once at the root of your app.
Use the useToast hook to trigger toasts from anywhere in the tree.
Keep toast messages brief — a title and optionally one short description sentence.
Use 'danger' sparingly for truly critical failures.
Provide onClose handling for toasts that should persist.
dont: Do not use Toast for inline validation errors — use FormControl instead.
Do not stack more than 3 toasts simultaneously.
Do not place interactive elements inside a toast.
